Business domain map

What Bunkai is for, how it intends to earn, and what every domain term means. Reverse-engineered from upex-bunkai-tms at main commit e88512e. Every path below is relative to that repository; db:<table> is a table in supabase/migrations/; route:<path> is a page or API route of the app.

Overview

Confidence: Medium. The product purpose is stated consistently in code metadata and the in-repo product docs, and the schema matches the authoring half of that purpose. The docs describe a much larger product than the code at e88512e implements (tests, runs, bugs, dashboards are not in the schema), so everything beyond authoring is intent, not behaviour.

Problem statement

Bunkai is a Test Management System (TMS). Its own metadata calls it an "Open-core Test Management System. ATCs (Atomic Test Components), modular tests, full traceability" (app/layout.tsx). The product docs frame the problem as existing TMSs (Xray, Zephyr Scale, TestRail, qTest) acting as document vaults: duplicated steps across test cases, missing traceability from user story to test to bug, and pass-rate reports that do not say what is validated (.context/business/business-model.md, .context/PRD/executive-summary.md; marketing-toned prose, so confidence is downgraded).

The answer the code already enforces is structural: an ATC cannot be saved without a user story and at least one acceptance criterion (app/(app)/projects/[projectSlug]/atcs/[atcId]/actions.ts, FK atcs.user_story_id in supabase/migrations/0004_atcs.sql). Traceability is a property of the data model, not an optional field.

Target users

  • QA engineers and QA leads working inside a workspace, with the roles the database enforces: viewer, member, admin, owner (supabase/migrations/0001_tenancy.sql).
  • Programmatic operators (CLI, CI, AI agents) that authenticate with a Personal Access Token (supabase/migrations/0008_access_tokens.sql, lib/api/middleware/bearer.ts).
  • Named personas in the docs (senior QA engineer, QA lead, developer, autonomous AI test agent) are intent only (.context/PRD/executive-summary.md).

Value proposition (delivered at e88512e)

  • Multi-tenant workspaces with role-based membership and email invite links (route:/workspaces/[id]/members).
  • A project tree of modules, user stories and acceptance criteria browsed in an Explorer sidebar (components/layout/Sidebar.tsx).
  • An ATC library table and an ATC editor with steps, assertions, tags, layer and mandatory anchoring (components/atcs/).
  • A versioned REST API with OpenAPI docs and token auth for non-browser callers (app/api/v1/, route:/api/docs).

Not delivered at this commit, though promised by the docs: tests as chains of ATCs, execution runs, native bug management, coverage dashboards, Jira sync (see discovery gaps).

QA relevance

Business aspectTesting implication

Workspace

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
WorkspaceWorkspace, workspace_id"Workspace" (Create workspace, workspace switcher)workspacessupabase/migrations/0001_tenancy.sql, lib/types.ts

Business meaning: the tenant. A team's private space; every project, module, story and ATC belongs to exactly one workspace, and a person sees only the workspaces they are an active member of. It has a URL slug, a name, an owner and a plan tier.

UI labels: onboarding form with name (placeholder "Acme QA") and slug (placeholder "acme-qa"), button "Create workspace", toast "Workspace created"; switcher toast "Workspace switched." The active workspace is remembered in a cookie separate from the session (lib/api/workspace-cookie.ts).

Related terms: Workspace member, Workspace invite, Project.

Abbreviations: ws (code helpers, e.g. bunkai_is_workspace_member(ws_id)).

Structure: pending; the business-data-context map is still a placeholder (see discovery gaps).

Workspace invite

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Invite (invite link)workspace_invites, workspace_invite_secrets"Generate invite link", "Invite revoked.", "Joining workspace…"workspace_invites (+ secret hash in workspace_invite_secrets)supabase/migrations/0010_workspace_invites.sql, app/api/v1/workspaces/[id]/invites/route.ts

Business meaning: an admin's offer for a specific email to join a workspace with a given role (never owner). It is shared as a link, expires after a default window, and can be revoked or rotated (a new link replaces the old). Accepting it requires being signed in.

UI labels: "Generate invite link", placeholder "teammate@company.com", "No invites yet.", toasts "Invite revoked.", "New invite link copied to clipboard."; accept page "Checking session…", "Joining workspace…", "Welcome — you have joined the workspace."

Related terms: Workspace, Workspace member.

Lifecycle note: the invite's state is derived from timestamps (accepted_at, revoked_at, expires_at), not a status column; its state machine belongs to the data map.

ATC

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
ATC (Atomic Test Component)Atc, AtcLayer, AtcStatus, bunkai_save_atc"ATC", "All ATCs", "ATCs in project", "Save ATC", "New ATC"atcssupabase/migrations/0004_atcs.sql, components/atcs/AtcEditor.tsx

Business meaning: the product's central unit: one small, reusable verification of a single observable behaviour, written as ordered steps plus assertions, placed in a module, tagged, classified by test layer, and anchored to a user story and its criteria. Every save bumps its version. It also carries its latest result status.

UI labels: editor fields "Title" (required, placeholder "A single observable behaviour — start with a verb"), "Module", "Layer", "Steps" ("markdown · one step per numbered line"), "Assertions" ("YAML list · checked by every executor"), "Tags" (placeholder "regression, smoke, P1…"), panel "Anchoring" (valid / missing); toast "ATC saved". Table columns "ID", "Title", "Layer", "Module", "Status", "Tags".

Naming conflict: the app metadata and product docs expand ATC as "Atomic Test Component" (app/layout.tsx); the schema comment expands it as "Acceptance Test Case" (supabase/migrations/0004_atcs.sql). Use "ATC" in test names; see discovery gaps.

Related terms: ATC step, ATC assertion, Anchoring, Module, User story. Values: ATC layer, ATC status.

Structure: pending (data map placeholder). The status enum has six values, so it needs a state machine in the data map.

Anchoring

Business nameCode identifierUI labelTable / collectionFound in
Anchoring (ATC to criteria binding)AtcAcceptanceCriterion, isAnchored, p_ac_ids"Anchoring" (valid / missing)atc_acceptance_criteria (many-to-many) + atcs.user_story_idsupabase/migrations/0004_atcs.sql, components/atcs/AnchoringPanel.tsx

Business meaning: the traceability rule that defines the product: an ATC is anchored when it names one user story and at least one of that story's acceptance criteria. The editor will not save an unanchored ATC. The "at least one criterion" part is enforced in the application layer, not by a database constraint.

Discovery gaps

The following items could not be verified from code and require human confirmation:

  • Tests, Runs, Bugs are not in the schema. The docs and the backlog (epics for tests as chains of ATCs, manual execution runs, bugs and defect heatmap, coverage and traceability) describe them, and the UI shows a "New Test" button, but no table or route exists at e88512e. No term- section was written for them. Source: Jira project BK and the target's later branches.
  • ATC expansion conflict. "Atomic Test Component" (app/layout.tsx, product docs) vs "Acceptance Test Case" (supabase/migrations/0004_atcs.sql header). Which one the team uses in tickets is unconfirmed.
  • No creation UI for authoring entities. No page, action or API route inserts projects, modules, user stories, acceptance criteria or ATCs; the "New ATC" and "New Test" buttons have no handler, and bunkai_save_atc only updates an existing ATC. How data enters the system (seed scripts, direct SQL) is unknown.
  • Revenue Streams and Cost Structure rest on the business doc only (Low confidence); no billing, pricing or plan gating in code.
  • Unused schema. activity_log, feature_flags and user_view_state have no reader or writer in app code; which endpoints require an idempotency key is unverified.
  • Member status values invited and suspended are declared but never set by code; their business meaning is inferred from the names.
  • No i18n bundle. UI labels come from component JSX; the QA guide page (app/qa/) is in Spanish while the app UI is in English. Confirm the product's official UI language.
  • Structure pointers. Every term's attributes, relationships and lifecycle (ATC status, invite lifecycle, token lifecycle) belong to the business-data-context map, which is still a placeholder. Generate it with project-context mode data, then point each term at its section.
  • Diagrams. No figure drawn: this map is tables by design (figures are optional here); a relationship overview can be added later after the diagrams capability check.
